text: Wanchat Restaurant, serving roasted pork and crispy pork, is located opposite Tops. I ordered the special crispy pork rice for 50 baht, with an added egg for 5 baht. The crispy pork was delicious, but the sauce was very sweet. The portion was a bit small.

text: Convenient location, parking isn't crowded. Durian is reasonably priced at 199 baht per fruit. A can of Chang Classic beer is the cheapest among the shops in this area at 33 baht.
